name: think
description: Think a vague feature idea into a buildable spec by working backwards (the idea→spec leg; drives the `devague` CLI). Start from the announcement ("pretend it shipped"), capture and classify claims, interrogate them with honesty conditions and hard questions, park open vagueness as a first-class object, and export a spec only once the frame *converges*. Use when the user says "think this through", "spec this", "work backwards", "turn this idea into a spec", "announcement frame", or "devague", or when a feature request is too vague to build yet. Once a spec exports, hand off to the sibling /spec-to-plan skill to turn it into a plan. Authored and maintained in agentculture/devague (origin = devague); steward pulls this skill from here and broadcasts it to the AgentCulture mesh — it is NOT vendored from steward like the other skills here.
